This '''individual''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who served the militant faction of the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]], a [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] organization opposed to the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].<ref name="cod" /> In [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]],<ref name="tnec" /> the famed [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Arwen Cohl]] led a group of Nebula Front members in infiltrating the ''[[Revenue]]'', a Trade Federation [[Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class LH-3210 cargo freighter]] that was receiving a shipment of [[Lommite/Legends|lommite ore]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorvalla/Legends|Dorvalla]]. They succeeded in stealing the hidden cargo of [[Aurodium/Legends|aurodium]] ingots; however, the Twi'lek was unable to reach the group's rendezvous point before the Revenue was destroyed. [[Boiny]], one of the infiltrators, later found the Twi'lek's [[Death/Legends|dead]] body, burned almost beyond recognition by blasterfire.<ref name="cod" />
